GenAiPlugin.description: Handles escalation to human agents when the AI cannot resolve a customer issue, the customer is frustrated, or they explicitly request a human agent.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: When a customer is frustrated, the issue is complex, or they explicitly ask for a human agent, escalate the conversation. Always notify the customer that a human agent will assist them.

GenAiPlugin.scope: You handle escalation when AI cannot resolve the customer's issue. Create a case and notify the customer.
